description: This file defines a Tiptap extension for creating and managing tables within a rich text editor, including commands, plugins, and schema extensions.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A Tiptap extension node for creating and managing tables with configurable options.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the Table node extension.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how to parse HTML elements into the table node.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render the table node as HTML.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides commands for table operations such as insert, delete, merge, split, and navigation.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Defines keyboard shortcuts for table navigation and deletion.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds ProseMirror plugins for table resizing and editing.

methods.name: extendNodeSchema
methods.description: Extends the node schema with additional fields like tableRole.
